thread:
alex: Pushed a docs PR that updates the model-catalog deprecation entry and adds an SDK snippet for embeddings. Need approvals + a clean preview before tomorrow's RC cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

priya: Thanks Alex — pinging reviewers @jamal @maria. What are blocking items right now?

jamal: The SDK snippet currently uses the old Client.embed(...) call. In v0.12 the API changed to client.embeddings.create(), so the preview build throws an error. I can patch in a minute.

maria: Also we need a short migration blurb and a one-line release-note that marketing can reuse. Make sure the deprecation window (90 days) is explicit.

docs-bot: Preview build started: https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app (will update when ready)

alex: CI shows a broken internal link to /model-catalog/migration in the new section, that's failing the link checker.

ci-bot: docs build failed — broken link check. Logs: https://ci.redwood/12345/console (link-checker: exit code 1)

jamal: Quick patch coming. Replacing snippet with the new API and adding a tiny note about parameter rename. New snippet:

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.embeddings.create(model="rw-embed-1", input="hello")
print(resp.data[0].embedding)
```

I pushed the fix to the same branch.

priya: Once jamal's commit lands I'll re-run the preview. Our merge window is tight — we need it merged before 10:00am PT so the nightly changelog snapshot picks it up. Suggest approve after preview passes. :eyes:

maria: I'll draft the release-note blurb now: "Deprecate old RW model variants in favor of consolidated rw-embed-* family. See migration notes for SDK changes." Will post in a follow-up.

alex: I also fixed the broken link (typo in path) and added a cURL example for people using the HTTP endpoint. Pushing that change now.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview-842--redwood-docs.netlify.app (build succeeded)

ci-bot: All checks passed ✅ — link-checker, linter, and preview deployment green.

priya: LGTM from docs side. @alex please squash commits and merge after 09:45 PT so CI artifacts are stable and changelog script can pick the PR.

alex: Will squash+merge at 09:48 PT. Thanks everyone :rocket: 

jamal: I'll add a short note to the SDK CHANGELOG about the rename and the code example.

maria: I'll post final release-blurb to #marketing once this merges. Good catch on the link, alex.

alex: Done — merged and added the changelog PR reference in the release-note draft. Closing this thread.
